translated: The aura of my beloved goddess, so long awaited...

The ideal of becoming one with you
and becoming the world's creator, now...
At last, it will be realized...

Welcome, kindred.
To think you'd hurry here to congratulate me...
All of it shall be mine!
...was not as all-powerful as I had hoped.
No being can dominate the heart...

The sin of toying with many souls.
The sin of wreaking destruction with the power of the divine lance.
Atone for it with the extinction of your soul...
